sourceText:
The Federation
By: Simmer + Sauce
Published: Friday, January 12, 2018 - 12:36pm

Ingredients




Pernod (or another Absinthe), for rinsing the glass
2 ounces Anejo Tequila
1/2 ounce Creme de Cacao
2 dashes Angostura bitters
orange peel, for garnish

Preparation

1 Use a rocks glass and rinse lightly with Pernod. Discard liquid. Add a few pieces of ice to the glass. 2 Add the tequila, Creme de Cacao and bitters. Gently stir. 3 Garnish with an orange peel.

About

Tequila fan? The Federation is a smooth Anejo tequila cocktail that will warm you up on a cold winter night.
